findings.observation: 5 failed protected publication gates were recorded (5 unclassified causes).
findings.action: Read original failed job logs, record real causes and move the relevant existing validation before the next readiness signal; do not replay the released edition.

findings.observation: 6 rejected image candidates preceded the verified six-image release.
findings.action: Inspect saved rejection evidence and apply source-specific geometry, causal-arrow and label corrections before the next native generation.

limitations: This report records findings and next actions; it does not execute corrections.
Existing owners must fix safe same-cycle faults immediately, without waiting for the cumulative review date.
A released edition remains immutable; lessons apply prospectively to the next genuine cycle.
Missing observations are not zero; no causality, autonomous recovery or effectiveness is inferred.

top10_resilience.interpretation: A documented editorial sensitivity check, not a popularity score or proof of publisher independence.

limits: Seven calendar edition dates; missing observations are gaps, never zero.
Source counts and registry/method changes limit comparison; no causal improvement claim.
Source contribution covers only resource-attributed substantive review records; it is not an exhaustive source ranking.
No last inspection record means not recorded, not proof the source was never read.
Image defects may have multiple codes per rejected attempt; category totals are not attempt totals.
Recorded recovery mode is not first-party scheduler attestation.
Keep/revise/retire reviews do not automatically change production controls.
